native_result.query: The effect of which variable on BA degree completion decreases from 0.5024 to 0.0923 (while becoming insignifcant) when both SES and academic characteristics are included in analysis?
native_result.HypoA: The effect of SES on BA degree completion decreases from 0.3636  (significant) to  -0.2293 (insignificant) and effect of race on BA degree completion decreases from 0.5024  (significant) to 0.0923 (insignificant) when academic characteristics are considered.
native_result.HypoB: SES is the variable: the effect of socioeconomic status on BA degree completion falls from about 0.5024 to about 0.0923 and becomes statistically insignificant once academic characteristics are included alongside SES. The same pattern reproduces here as a logistic coefficient of 0.4729 (p<1e-24) for SES alone falling to 0.0814 (p=0.372) - an 82.8% reduction - when class percentile (academic characteristics) enters the model, and 0.4760 -> 0.0798 (p=0.383) with a sex dummy held fixed; the odds ratio drops from 1.60 to 1.08. The collapse is one-directional: adding SES to the academic block leaves ABILITY and PERCENTILE essentially unchanged (<=1.6% change, p<1e-5), and no other candidate (family size, race, sex) combines ~80-99% shrinkage, preserved sign and loss of significance across logistic, LPM and probit specifications or across raw/z/0-1 scalings (SES alone flips in 9/9 family x scaling cells). In other words the SES-BA relationship is mediated by academic characteristics: students from higher-SES families complete BA degrees largely because they attain higher class rank and test performance, and once that is controlled SES has no independent effect.
native_result.WorkflowB: Inspection (shape/dtypes/headers/missing/sentinels/duplicates/descriptives) -> block-structured nested logistic models with SES held out of the academic block, fitted in both directions (academic -> academic+SES, and SES -> SES+academic) for every candidate predictor -> scaling grid (raw/z/min-max) and family grid (logit/LPM/probit) plus HC1-robust SEs and subsample replication, with per-model convergence/separation flags -> exhaustive 9,310-cell nested-pair enumeration used only as a multiplicity control to test whether any specification reproduces 0.5024 exactly -> decision rule on |coef| pair proximity, significance flip and sign preservation.
